'''Landai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Landai was a member of a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] led by Master [[Surro]], and the group adopted a sixth line to the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]&mdash;"There is no contemplation, there is only duty." The team served as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] scouts on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] after [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] [[Cheketta]]'s defeat at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]],<ref name="Sixth Line Part One" /> and the group suffered a loss when one of their number, [[Danak]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Imperials after being exposed by a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Ivo (Balmorran)|Ivo]].<ref name="Sixth Line Part Two">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20150428|text="The Sixth Line: Part Two"|int=The Sixth Line}}</ref> [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, the group&mdash;now officially known as the [[Sixth Line]] and in the employ of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]&mdash;was deployed on the planet [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] by [[Theron Shan]], but Landai and the others fell under the control of the former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]]. During the [[Invasion of Ziost]] that followed, Vitiate used Landai and Master [[Onok]] as puppets, and the two were defeated in battle in the [[People's Tower]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[New Adasta]].<ref name="Dead Center" /> During the [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|final confrontation]] with Tenebrae, Landai was among the spirits witnessing his final death.<ref name="Echoes">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=General|Echoes of Oblivion|Kira Carsen's ship}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Landai was first introduced in the short story [[The Sixth Line]], released shortly before Game Update 3.2: Rise of the Emperor was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Landai and Onok appear in the mission "Dead Center" in the update, and players can choose to shock them into unconsciousness, earning light side alignment points, or kill them, earning dark side alignment points.
